customTitle: Displaying scaled images in p5.js sketch for better visibility.

message.text:
This is a p5js sketch that takes in 2 images, analyzes them, and recreates one image (layoutSource) with pieces from the other (tileSource). It displays 3 canvases - the main canvas, the tileLayer, and the layoutLayer.

Currently the canvas elements are all displayed at full-size.. For large images, this can be difficult to see on the screen. I want to display the 2 source layers to the left of the default canvas, scaled to fit on-screen. The scaling can be done via css, or by adding 2 new scaled graphics elements, keeping the full-size graphics off-screen. Which approach is more appropriate, and why?

Right now, the 3 canvases are displayed one after the other. Please add some CSS so that the 2 source canvases are on the left, tileLayer above the layoutLayer, and the main default canvas to the right of both.
Getting closer, but the the two scaled layers (canvases) are far apart, and the main canvas is underneath the tilelayer. Can you fix this without using tables?
